notes: The prompt self-declares a simulator and the content is cars on a free map, with no lap and no finish, so it is Simulation on Vehicle Sim and the preset's world-open shape stands as the shared world everyone drives in. The answers make the map a palace and its grounds, compact enough to cross in about a minute, so it is one small continuous surface rather than several zones. I kept path-road-vehicle for the drives and approach roads around the grounds and dropped resource-shared, since nothing is extracted; settlement-density was not taken because a palace with grounds is one landmark building rather than built-up ground. Decided without a user: three cars and the promised later car updates are content rather than layout so nothing was placed for them, there is no shop or currency described so no social-hub or gate-progression, and with the palace treated as an exterior the build stays on P0.
